newsitem.title: ROMANIA: BUCHAREST BOURSE UP IN NEW BUYING ROUND.
newsitem.headline: BUCHAREST BOURSE UP IN NEW BUYING ROUND.

text.p: Renewed heavy buying of Bucharest bourse stocks hoisted volumes and most average prices on Tuesday and traders saw the pattern continuing for a while.
Two unofficial indices, the VAB and the BIG, edged up by 3.7 and 2.57 percent respectively from the previous session. The BIG first-tier index rose 2.59 percent to 3,225.97 points.
"Buying was intense today and there were several cross trades and in-house deals which pushed up stocks," said a trader.
Volumes climbed to 3.2 million shares from 2.4 million on Monday, and turnover rose by 3.3 billion lei to 11.3 billion.
"First-tier stocks remained investors' darlings," another trader said. "Their average prices moved ahead and three high-caps also closed higher."
The four first-tier listings accounted for some 77 percent of turnover.
Azomures fertiliser maker gained 150 lei to close at 3,300, unaffected by a company announcement saying it had to dismiss 200 staff due to a decline in sales.
Chemical plant Oltchim ended 150 lei firmer at 2,500 and pharmaceuticals company Terapia inched up 100 lei to close at 6,250.
Antibiotice medicine maker, the fourth listing on the first tier, closed flat at 5,100 lei.

The second tier was more active, with volumes almost doubling to 665,000 shares. The average prices of 11 stocks moved higher, six slipped and six remained unchanged. Six companies had no trade and three were suspended.
Policolor dye maker dominated second-tier trading with a turnover level of 1.9 billion lei and a closing quote 200 lei stronger at 5,300.
